svg.title: Equipment SME architecture with deployed Bedrock Guardrails
svg.desc: Streamlit sends equipment logs through API Gateway to the application Lambda and Bedrock Nova Pro. Bedrock sends text invocation logs and native metrics to CloudWatch. A Nova Pro log subscription invokes a notification Lambda, which publishes metadata-only messages with token counts to SNS for a confirmed email subscriber. Bedrock Guardrails evaluate model input and output; contextual grounding compares the summary with the supplied logs. Lambda handles blocked results. Bedrock Guardrails are deployed. Serverless Framework and CloudFormation deploy the resources and a separate logging configuration Lambda. Invocation logs have 30-day retention. Notifications are asynchronous and at least once; they do not cap spending.
svg.text: Application requests, deployed Bedrock Guardrails, logging, and email notifications
Generated findings return to the UI along the same request path.

g.text: Input: denied topics, content, and prompt-attack checks
Output: content + source grounding + query relevance
Lambda applies the policy and returns helpful guidance when blocked.

svg.text: 3. Deployment and permissions - separate from the request path
Serverless Framework > CloudFormation > logging configuration Lambda (deployment lifecycle only)
Scoped IAM roles: application > Nova Pro; Bedrock > log stream; notifier > SNS; configuration helper > logging setup + PassRole.
CloudFormation manages the deployed versioned guardrail; application IAM permits its use. No additional Lambda is needed.
Nova Pro records cover this account and Region. Email delivery is asynchronous and at least once; it does not cap spending.
